title: Anthropic Faces a Longer Wait Than SpaceX to Join Indexes
summary: Anthropic’s planned initial public offering could generate billions of dollars in demand from index-tracking funds, though the artificial intelligence startup may have to wait longer than SpaceX did to join two major stock benchmarks.

title: Nvidia Scandal Has Raised ‘Red Flags,’ California AG Says
summary: California Attorney General Rob Bonta said that his office is looking into aspects of the scandal that’s engulfed Nvidia Corp. and its former chief executive officer, Jensen Huang.

title: US Electronic Spy Agency Suffers Classified Network Outage
summary: The National Security Agency is suffering an outage of a classified computer network it uses for internal communications and other daily work functions, according to a US official and another person familiar with the matter.

title: Nvidia to Face Its New AI Reality
summary: Get a jump start on the US trading day with Dani Burger on "Bloomberg Open Interest." Nvidia takes center stage, reporting without Jensen Huang as the tech trade faces fresh pressure. Home Depot kicks off retail earnings as consumers keep spending, while Disney beats expectations and Anthropic’s blockbuster IPO demand pushes pricing to the top of the range or higher. Plus, Meredith Whitney joins us on consumer strain, AI risks and whether the fallout could spread to banks and the broader economy. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Trump Seeks $50 Billion for Airspace Upgrades After Outage
summary: President Donald Trump’s administration formally requested $50.1 billion to overhaul the US airspace system, citing an “urgent need” to modernize the critical infrastructure after a technology breakdown grounded flights nationwide last week.

title: OpenAI Unveils New Astra AI Model After Scrapping Prior Release
summary: OpenAI is releasing a new version of its most advanced Astra artificial intelligence model nearly two months after the company scrapped a prior update to establish stronger safeguards for the technology.

title: Nvidia’s Jensen Huang Open to Rejoining as CEO Pending Board Decision
summary: Former Nvidia Corp. Chief Executive Officer Jensen Huang expressed willingness to return to the helm after his dramatic ouster last week, though the board isn’t currently considering such an idea.

title: JPMorgan Warns Leveraged-Loan Defaults Set to Double in 2027
summary: Defaults in the leveraged-loan market are expected to more than double to 4.5% next year, reaching levels not seen since 2024 as heavily indebted companies face mounting financial pressure, according to analysts at JPMorgan Chase & Co.

title: EM Stocks Retreat Ahead of Nvidia, While Currencies Gain Ground
summary: Emerging-market stocks retreated for the fourth straight session as upcoming earnings from Nvidia Corp. kept traders on edge, while currencies extended gains after reports of another US outage pushed the dollar lower.

title: New Street's Ferragu Sees Strong Case to Buy Nvidia Shares Ahead of Earnings
summary: Pierre Ferragu of New Street Research maintains a buy rating on Nvidia shares and says the recent selloff strengthens the case to buy. He says the resignation of CEO Jensen Huang won't affect near-term earnings. Ferragu speaks on "Bloomberg Surveillance." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Read Jensen Huang’s Statement Offering a Return as Nvidia CEO
summary: After his chaotic exit from Nvidia Corp. last week, former Chief Executive Officer Jensen Huang said he’s received an “outpouring” of support from people calling for his return.

title: Big US Grid Proposes Overhaul to Speed Data Center Connections
summary: The largest US grid is proposing a “fast energization” plan to speed up connection for data centers and power plants in response to criticism from regulators that PJM Interconnection LLC is struggling to keep pace with surging demand while costs rise for consumers.

title: Take-Two’s Firaxis, Maker of ‘Civilization,’ Cuts a Third of Its Staff
summary: The Maryland-based development studio behind the Civilization and XCOM franchises, laid off around 60 people on Tuesday

title: Compute Futures Aim to Hedge AI Risks
summary: Carmen Li, founder and CEO of Silicon Data and CEO of the Compute Exchange joined Bloomberg Open Interest to talk about how compute futures could give financiers and AI companies a way to hedge shifting GPU costs and supply risks. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: De Nvidia a los humanoides: EE.UU. vs. China: en la carrera por la IA
summary: Tanto EE.UU. como China ven en la inteligencia artificial el nuevo epicentro de su rivalidad económica. El presidente estadounidense, Donald Trump, ha declarado que “quien gane en IA, gana”. La cuestión es si ambas potencias pueden dejar de lado sus diferencias y cooperar para crear un entorno seguro y sostenible para el desarrollo de esta tecnología.

title: 2026 is Year Where the 'AI Boom Became Debt Finance,' Says Wigglesworth
summary: Robin Wigglesworth, columnist at The Financial Times, discusses his book "A Fabulous Debt" and how bond markets have evolved over the years. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Iceye’s Bid for Rocket Firm Avio Gets Positive Response in Italy
summary: Iceye Oy’s proposed tie-up with Avio SpA would give a boost to European efforts to secure independent access to space, according to the Italian rocket-launch company’s biggest shareholder.

title: Consumer Strain Meets AI’s Reality Check
summary: Consumers are making tough choices as housing and food costs stay high and lending tightens according to Meredith Whitney, CEO of the Meredith Whitney Advisory Group. She joined Bloomberg Open Interest to talk about why Nvidia’s selloff is raising questions about chip demand, delayed data centers and circular financing, and whether AI risks could spread through banks and the broader economy. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Top AI Models Regularly Identify Civilians as Military Targets in Tests
summary: Advanced artificial intelligence models in simulated scenarios regularly misidentified civilians, ambulances, surrendering soldiers and a school in Iran as military targets, according to a new independent research report.

title: Nvidia Growth Guidance Is Pivotal Point to Watch, Luria Says
summary: Gil Luria, head of technology research at DA Davidson, explains why growth guidance is the main point to watch for in Nvidia’s earnings call after the bell Tuesday. He says it would be “more alarming” if the company has to pull growth guidance today, as it would be ‘a big leg down’ for the stock. He speaks on Bloomberg Television. (Source: Bloomberg)
